# Synthetic OMP file-observer fixtures

These fixtures are generated by `synthetic.mjs`; no transcript, account, config, or credential is copied from a real coding agent. The fixture producer alone mutates files, under unique repository-local `test-results-omp-unit/case-*` directories. Cleanup only removes the producer's own directory.

Reference schema: OMP JSONL v3 at source commit `6a86df8539fccf3ad7818081266e554022fc21bc`. This is a static reference, not certification of the user's installed OMP build. The pinned source links are in the plan's `evidence.md`.

## Expected behavior and coverage

| Area | Expected evidence | Current boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Header/title/version (F1/F2) | Optional single 256-byte UTF-8 title slot; v3 header accepted; unsupported schemas rejected; header-only historical | No live runtime-to-lazy-file attachment |
| Framing (F3/F4) | One-byte reads exercise UTF-8/JSON/CRLF boundaries; only newline-terminated records consumed; malformed/oversized data is bounded and incomplete | No production polling scheduler |
| Rewrite (F5/F6) | Truncate, atomic replacement, deletion/reappearance, title/middle rewrite and rewrite+append rebuild epochs; old complete snapshot remains refreshing | Move/rename discovery is not implemented |
| Branches (F7) | Parent tree plus captured/missing/null/dangling leaf, reset boundary and compaction produce the selected active-context view; cycles/missing/capped data is incomplete | No API conversation pagination yet |
| Lineage (F8) | Fork/continuation marked as inherited history; previous exit marker never proves current liveness | Child/artifact/advisor discovery (F9) is not implemented |
| Read faults (F10) | ENOENT differs from EACCES/EMFILE/EIO; diagnostics contain codes, not raw paths | Driver retry/backoff and source availability lifecycle remain pending |
| Paths (F11) | Traversal, drive/ADS/UNC, symlink/hardlink and identity-replacement negatives; explicit namespaced project/worktree mapping | Executed on WSL/Linux; native Windows junction/reparse behavior is unverified |
| Bounds (part of F12) | Single-reader single-flight, byte/line/index limits, fixed-block fingerprints, dispose and pre-cancel checks | Multi-file scheduling, catalogue pagination, pins, TTL/LRU, eviction and aggregate resource tests remain pending |
| Usage (file-only parts of U1-U4) | Missing differs from zero; assistant/model_usage ledger is idempotent; inherited scope explicit; incomplete totals and unknown context remain null | No file/bridge reconciliation or subtree/global spend aggregation |
| Privacy | Metadata contains no synthetic prompts/titles/arguments/results/custom payloads; explicit text-only content option; opaque-string redaction; read-only IO spy and source-hash assertion | No new HTTP/SSE/replay/browser privacy certification |

`readonlyIO()` exposes only read-side methods and counts handles and bytes. Tests assert read-only flags, closure and unchanged source hashes where the fixture producer is not changing the file. Fixtures contain intentionally inert HTML strings to test normalization; browser execution safety is not established by a unit test.

## Run

```sh
node --test tests/unit/omp-paths.test.mjs tests/unit/omp-reader.test.mjs tests/unit/omp-normalize.test.mjs tests/unit/omp-usage.test.mjs
```

The 2026-10-31 final focused run passed 37/37. The final full `npm test` run passed 132/132. These are core unit results, not G3 completion. See `plans/261030-1754-omp-multi-agent-integration/reports/phase-03-implementation.md` for exact scope, tool blocker and remaining work.
